items.title: 68359_Zutty Singleton oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Well, this is before Nick La Rocca and people would put their name on Tiger Rag? [INTERVIEWEE] Yes I imagine so.

ctx.x: Jack Carey played trombone. Because they used to call 'Tiger Rag', instead of calling it 'Tiger Rag', they used to call it, 'play Jack Carey.' Because he was famous for his 'Tiger Rag' you know.
Well, this is before Nick La Rocca and people would put their name on Tiger Rag?
